scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.multiple_basis: NTM EV/Sales (own-history 5yr median — top of usable band)
scenarios.drivers: Trip/Gross-Bookings volume growth accelerates toward ~25% YoY and the driver/courier payment ratio improves ~2pp (earnings/07 bull case); the market credits the resulting growth/margin combination with a re-rate to the 5-year EV/Sales median, treating the FY2025-26 de-rating as sentiment-driven rather than structural.

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.multiple_basis: NTM EV/Sales (implied by the mechanically-weighted 4-method base point; independently cross-checks to an implied ~13.3x NTM EV/EBITDA, matching 03's own 13.2x)
scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §2 (mechanically-weighted blend of 02/03/04/06) and §3 (metric x multiple cross-check, reproduces within 0.2%)
scenarios.drivers: Growth continues to decelerate gradually in line with consensus (no shock either way); driver-payment ratio holds roughly flat to modestly improving; the pending Delivery Hero deal has not yet closed or moved net debt; the market grants modest credit for Uber's structurally higher margin base without assuming the 2021-era zero-rate multiple regime returns.

scenarios.label: bear_cyclical
scenarios.drivers: 12-month cyclical/deceleration case: Trip/Gross-Bookings growth decelerates further and the driver/courier payment ratio worsens ~2pp simultaneously (earnings/07 bear case); the multiple compresses to the low end of Uber's own 5-year trading range as the market re-prices slower growth and the just-drawn Delivery Hero-funding leverage. This is the headline Bear (worse of the two down-legs by a modest margin is bear_structural, see below).

scenarios.label: bear_structural
scenarios.drivers: 24-36 month autonomous-vehicle disruption case (avoid-ruin floor, not the headline bear): EBIT margin fades from 11.0% (Yr5) to 7.0% (Yr10) vs. the base case's 13.2%→12.8%; terminal growth cut to 1.0% (structurally impaired, non-recovering franchise). Trigger: business-model/07_business-quality.md rates industry rate-of-change/disruption risk 32/100; Waymo already runs an independent commercialized robotaxi fleet. Routed to the avoid-ruin floor (not the headline Bear) because the moat is rated Narrow-but-widening, not eroding.
